subject: Helios Analytics — consolidated evidence bucket and acceptance windows for private offer
messages:
From: Carla Mendes <carla@heliosanalytics.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@heliosanalytics.com; procurement@heliosanalytics.com
Date: 2026-09-29T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal timing + evidence bucket for private offer (Helios)

Hi Dylan,

Hope you’re doing well. We’re reviewing the private offer for Helios and need to align acceptance windows and the evidence handoff for compliance. A few asks from our procurement and legal teams: 

- Can Redwood provide a single S3-style evidence bucket (or equivalent shared storage) where we can pull SOC2 / penetration test reports, acceptance test logs, and the audit log sample you mentioned?
- We need a proposed acceptance window (start/end dates) for the private offer activation and a short ramp schedule (canary + full cutover).
- What’s the billing/invoice cadence if we accept a 12-month term but split into two tranches? Our finance team needs an example invoice schedule.

I’ve attached a short evidence checklist (evidence_request.pdf) that our legal team uses — it lists the artifacts they require. If you can get a timeline and the bucket link by EOD Wednesday (PST), we can expedite internal approval.

Thanks,
Carla Mendes
Procurement Lead, Helios Analytics
carla@heliosanalytics.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: evidence_request.pdf (1 page)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carla Mendes <carla@heliosanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + evidence bucket for private offer (Helios)

Hi Carla — thanks for the clear checklist. Looping in Marissa (marketplace/private-offer lead) and Soojin (billing/ops) to coordinate the delivery. High-level proposal below; Marissa will follow up with exact DocuSign and acceptance artifact links.

Proposed acceptance & ramp (initial):
- Evidence bucket: we'll provision a read-only S3 bucket at https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/helios-acceptance (IAM link to be shared via secure transfer).
- Acceptance window (canary): 2026-10-04 00:00 UTC -> 2026-10-07 23:59 UTC (3 days) — limited load to validate routing, billing metrics, and KV cache warmup.
- Acceptance window (full cutover): 2026-10-08 00:00 UTC -> 2026-10-14 23:59 UTC (7 days) — full traffic; will validate performance SLOs and cost/runbook checks.
- Invoice tranches: we can support split invoicing (50/50 at acceptance and 6 months) or quarterly tranches; Soojin, please confirm the preferred template and sample invoice schedule.

Attachments: redwood-acceptance-checklist.xlsx (proposed template).

If those dates look good, Marissa will send the Docusign for signature and we can provision the evidence bucket with upload instructions. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if needed.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
+1 646-555-0199

Attachment: redwood-acceptance-checklist.xlsx (Excel, checklist)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Carla Mendes <carla@heliosanalytics.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + evidence bucket for private offer (Helios) — DocuSign and timeline

Hi Carla — thanks Dylan. Confirming the schedule and next steps from the marketplace side: 

1) DocuSign & paperwork
- I’ve attached the marketplace private offer package and the acceptance statement. Please review the DocuSign link below; it contains the contract + acceptance addendum we need signed for activation.
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Helios-RW-acceptance-link-placeholder

2) Evidence bucket and access
- We’ll provision the S3 bucket you requested and seed it with: SOC2 report (latest), pen test executive summary, sample audit logs (rolling 30-day window), and the acceptance runbook. We’ll provide temporary cross-account role + instructions once DocuSign is complete.

3) Acceptance windows & canary plan (operational detail)
- Canary (limited clients / 5% traffic): 2026-10-04 -> 2026-10-06. We’ll run hourly telemetry checks and share a nightly summary.
- Full acceptance: start 2026-10-08 08:00 UTC — Redwood will monitor SLOs for 7 days and keep auto-fallback to hosted API disabled for the initial window to observe behavior under your environment.

4) Billing / invoicing
- Soojin: recommended approach is two tranches: initial activation invoice at acceptance (50%), remainder at 180 days. We can also do net-30 for the initial invoice to align with Helios procurement if that helps cashflow.

Deliverables timeline (tentative):
- 2026-10-01: DocuSign bundle sent (Marissa)
- 2026-10-02: Evidence bucket provisioned and readme uploaded (Redwood infra)
- 2026-10-04: Canary window begins

Carla — can you confirm: (a) PO number or expected PO date, (b) preferred invoice cadence (50/50 or quarterly), and (c) whether your legal team needs any additional redlines on the acceptance addendum.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Marketplace Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0222

Attachment: marketplace-private-offer-docusign.pdf (PDF)

From: Carla Mendes <carla@heliosanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@heliosanalytics.com; legal@heliosanalytics.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + evidence bucket for private offer (Helios) — confirmed PO and invoice cadence

Marissa, Dylan — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the following from Helios: 

- PO: we will issue PO HL-4598 by 2026-10-03 and attach signed_po_helios.pdf once routed.
- Invoice cadence: 50/50 works for us; please set initial invoice net-30 after activation.
- Evidence bucket: the S3 link and IAM instructions look fine — we’ll validate once you provision.
- Canary ramp: we’d like the canary window limited to 48 hours (2026-10-04 -> 2026-10-05) and then pause for one day for review before full cutover on 2026-10-08. Is that operationally safe on your side?

A couple of asks from procurement/legal: can Redwood include a one-paragraph description of what constitutes “successful acceptance” (pass/fail criteria for the 7-day window) inside the DocuSign acceptance addendum so our legal team has clarity? Also, please include a copy of the sample invoice for our AP team.

If you’re good with the slight canary shortening and note for the acceptance criteria in the addendum, we’ll sign and route PO by 10/03.

Best,
Carla Mendes
Procurement Lead, Helios Analytics
carla@heliosanalytics.com

Attachment: signed_po_helios.pdf (to be attached after routing)
